description: This file contains the implementation of the SandboxNodeVisitor class within the Twig templating engine. It defines a class that implements the NodeVisitorInterface to traverse and modify Twig AST nodes, mainly for security and expression handling during template compilation.

classes.name: SandboxNodeVisitor
classes.description: Final class implementing Twig's NodeVisitorInterface to analyze and modify Twig AST nodes, primarily for security checks and expression wrapping during template processing.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Processes nodes upon entering during traversal, detecting specific node types for security considerations and expression wrapping.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Processes nodes upon leaving during traversal, finalizing modifications such as appending security check nodes.

methods.name: wrapNode
methods.description: Wraps specific node expressions with security or toString checks, depending on node type.

methods.name: wrapArrayNode
methods.description: Iterates over an array node's elements to wrap each with security checks.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the traversal priority for this node visitor, which is 0.
